name: @manuelselch/pi-verify
description: Composable evidence collection and verification reports for Pi workflows

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && vite build --config inspector.vite.config.mjs
scripts.test: npm run build && node --enable-source-maps --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include="**/src/**" --test-coverage-exclude="**/node_modules/**" --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=junit.xml --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=lcov.info --test dist/tests/*.test.js dist/tests/coverage/infra/*.test.js dist/tests/inspector/diagrams/domain/*.test.js dist/tests/inspector/diagrams/infra/*.test.js dist/tests/inspector/diagrams/ui/*.test.js
